properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Tuesday, October 3, [1933]; includes description of approval from New York and the Executive Yuan (Chinese government); next steps in Manila and Hong Kong; mentions Miss Forbes, Dai [Enki], L.C. Chun, T.V. Soong, Captain [Cecil “Pop”] Sellers, the minister of communications [Chu Chia-hua], and Dwight Bridge.
